m2_definition.definition: A complete rights-cleared PIN and typed office assignment passes authority, coverage, freshness, licence and digest gates.

scope: Read-only public source and access preflight. The existing complete assignment criterion, 13 blockers and separate M3 geometry/M4 building stages are unchanged. No credential or default Swagger API-key value is used.

references.edition: 2025-05-27 announcement; not a downloaded boundary or office assignment release
undated live explanatory page; not a current PIN assignment or pinned encoder release

markers: Services Available For Registered Portal Users
API Key generation and access of API URLs using API Key
references.edition: undated public help; not account access authorization

rules: An HTTP 200, expected title or GODL footer cannot override a sandbox banner, placeholder date, empty result or missing artifact.
Remove scripts, styles, comments and head metadata before assessing server-rendered body markers; title-only and embedded boot payloads are not displayed dataset content.
Static download-link counts are diagnostics only, not proof that JavaScript downloads or all public sources are unavailable. Never follow links automatically.
GODL allows reuse for covered data with attribution and other conditions; a verified legal page is not an exact resource rights/edition binding or source-data snapshot.
Swagger query-filter types do not define response field types. A numeric PIN filter never authorizes numeric storage or loses the six-character text identity.
Preserve multiple offices per PIN, office types and delivery status; no complete assignment data were obtained, so quality rates are null, not zero-percent errors.
Do not use or export Swagger default credentials, contacts or arbitrary API messages; never log in, register, accept terms, call third-party lookups or send location queries.
PIN geometry, DIGIPIN grids, administrative context, civic-address/building relations and AGID cells remain independent. No official geometry is generated from missing data.
